description: This file is a shell script for testing support for reading configuration data from a blob in git. It contains multiple test cases that create, manipulate, and verify blob-based configurations using git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a descriptive message and a series of shell commands that should succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, verifying correct error handling.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern appears in a file, used for verifying error messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes, used in test setup.

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Runs commands outside of a git repository context to verify error handling.
